subject: Blessfest 2026 — review the copy for your 8 areas
htmlBody:
Hi Christian,

I've drafted the area pages for the Blessfest 2026 website — every area of service has its own page where volunteers read what they'd be doing and sign up. Before this goes any further, I'd like the four of us to review the wording.

The 8 areas that report to you:

  • Nails — Sandra Angulo
  • Food Prep / Kitchen — Zack Moore
  • Food Service — David & Sunny Barrs
  • Dining Room Hosts — KC Mercer
  • Dental — Kent Toca
  • Optometry — Katie Kinoshita
  • Boutique — Becky Kopeny
  • Craft — Susan Bauerle

Attached is one Word document per area with everything that page currently says — the description, what volunteers will do, who's needed, and any requirements. Please correct anything that's wrong or that you'd put differently, and send them back. You can type right into the documents — don't worry about formatting, just get the words right and I'll handle the rest.

One exception in your batch: Optometry is fully staffed by Marshall B. Ketchum University, so its page doesn't ask for volunteers at all — it just tells people the service exists. Its document looks a little different, and I was guessing at most of that copy, so it especially needs your eye.

So you can see the whole picture

The site lists 17 “areas of service” — these are what a volunteer can actually sign up for:

Hair · Nails · Clothing · Food Prep / Kitchen · Food Service · Dining Room Hosts · Janitorial · Prayer / Evangelism · Welcome / Greeter · Guest Check-In · Children's Ministry · Dental · Optometry · Boutique · Craft · Setup Team · Tear Down Team

A number of things on our leadership roster are deliberately not on the site, so don't read their absence as an oversight:

  • Support and back-of-house roles we aren't recruiting the public for: Legal, Formstack, Media / MC / Music, AV, Worship, Video / Photo, Volunteer Registration, Volunteer Placement / Name Tags, First Response, Emergency Response, Shelter Contact / Transportation, Hygiene Kit Collection, and Photobooth.
  • Partner organizations rather than areas of service: Ketchum, Starbucks, WCHS, and Lestonnac.
  • Optometry is listed, but flagged “fully staffed” — no sign-up.

If you think something in that list deserves its own page — or that something with a page shouldn't have one — tell me and I'll change it.

Thanks,
Christian
